description: Set exposure level 0-100 (0 darkest → 100 brightest), mapped onto the device's exposure range. Also returns `raw`: the device-native exposure value the level mapped to, for diagnostics — `level` is the number to reason with. Uses the proprietary V3 frame protocol (CAM_SET_EXPOSURE_TINY2, which carries mode and value in one command) because the standard UVC/IAMCameraControl V4L2 path is a stub on the Tiny 2.
name: obsbot_image_exposure_manual
